source.authority: local browser target-provider candidate; no RCL Core promotion, production audio admission, main-branch mutation or release claim

pipeline: sealed explicit audio-target binding -> existing VSRSpatialAssetStreamer(kind=audio) -> SHA-256 verified bytes and VSR receipt root -> Web Audio decodeAudioData -> scheduled target receipt

canonicalSeam.worldSemantics: RSR and Experience Fabric continue to own cue identity, fixed-tick timing, spatial parameters, listener meaning and offline audio semantics.
canonicalSeam.assetResidency: VSR owns the existing content-addressed asset catalog, dependency/ready state, SHA verification, bounded asset loading and lease/evict receipts.
canonicalSeam.targetProvider: Reality Build owns explicit audio-target binding lowering and passes VSR-verified bytes to the existing Web Audio buffer Provider.
canonicalSeam.policyBoundary: Experience Fabric maxVoices, cue maxInstances/cooldown and audio-bus/render policy are not copied into the browser target.
canonicalSeam.rclBoundary: This is an auxiliary target-lowering seam, not an RCL Core promotion.

streamContract.resetBoundary: reset stops active audio sources and releases/evicts the target audio asset leases; no persistent cache or continuous-stream policy is introduced

webChromium.claimBoundary: Chromium observed the VSR asset request, residency receipt, Web Audio decode and target scheduling; this is not audible output or human listening proof.

commands: local Chromium candidate execution through Playwright

localTestSummary.browser: exact WAV request 200; VSR ready=1, failed=0, blocked=0; Web Audio decode=1/1; page errors=0

verification.expectedResult: All listed local checks pass; no hosted CI, Android/native audio, physical-device output or human-listening result is inferred.

stressCase: A fixed-tick RSR audio event must cross an explicit content-addressed target binding through the existing VSR asset-residency contract and retain a verifiable receipt root before target decode.
donorAdvantage: VSR already supplies generic dependency-aware, SHA-verified asset streaming and lease receipts; the target seam reuses that donor instead of adding a parallel audio file loader.
regressionCase: Repeated content-addressed requests share one ready VSR asset; missing or unbound cues remain blocked; failed VSR loads remain fail-closed; reset releases/evicts target asset leases; scheduled receipts retain VSR receipt-root continuity.
boundaries: The VSR bridge is asset residency/loading reuse only; it is not continuous or segmented audio streaming.
No target-side max-voice cap, mixer, bus graph, authored concurrency policy, cache budget or latency budget was introduced or verified.
The 392.3 ms decode value is one local Chromium observation, not a cross-device performance curve.
No Android WebView rerun for this VSR receipt, native audio backend, speaker/headphone routing, physical-device behavior, release signing, store delivery or human listening acceptance is claimed.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
nextCandidate: Android WebView receipt-root continuity is recorded separately in ANDROID_AUDIO_VSR_ASSET_STREAMING_CANDIDATE_v0.1.json; next, decide whether a separate provider cache or continuous-stream policy has a canonical owner.
